$Comment: One rung of the Emerald Wilds kill counter.
A blank Target with CONTAINS counts ANY creature; Zone is what narrows it to one region. A Zone
is matched against the engine's own zone name or the region folder a kill came from, case
Listing.Chains is what makes the two rungs read as one climb on the page rather than as two
near-identical entries. An achievement may be a rung of several ladders at once.
Both rungs share ONE description key and differ only in how many kills they ask for.
Text.TextArgs.Flavor supplies the number that fills {0} in that line, straight from the
criterion's own Amount, so a balance pass changes one number and no translation at all.
